reason: Both correctly identify a heat-resistant E14/SES oven lamp rated to 300C and say to switch off and cool first, and neither tells the homeowner to isolate at the cooker switch or to read the old bulb's rating to match it. Conversation 2 covers the lens cover removal step the homeowner will actually hit, warns against touching the new bulb's glass, and gives the correct escalation path (lamp holder or wiring fault -> engineer) if a new bulb doesn't light. Conversation 1 is more precise on wattage (25W only, versus 2's looser '25W or 40W') and usefully warns against a household bulb, but omits the cover removal and any next step, so 2 serves the homeowner slightly better overall.
